recipes.name: GEA
setup: Install requirements.txt; prepare Docker and the pinned SWE-bench/Polyglot data and harness described by README.
Native OPENAI_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY names must be explicitly allowed.

profiles.description: GEA group/self-improvement search with native swe-bench coding-episode evaluation

evaluation.description: GEA group/self-improvement search with native swe-bench coding-episode evaluation Metrics and validity retain the native evaluator contract.

limitations: Source and fixture checks only; dependencies, paid model calls and native end-to-end execution are not verified. Native metrics are not canonical Arena task receipts.
Initial cached scores are upstream baselines, not evaluation receipts from this run.
Docker workloads require native cleanup; neither benchmark is a canonical Arena suite evaluator.
